name: InFusionSurf
definition: A NeRF-style RGB-D 3D surface reconstruction framework that refines depth information to enhance reconstruction quality with minimal impact on optimization time, using per-frame intrinsic refinement and TSDF Fusion prior learning.
summary: InFusionSurf is a NeRF-style RGB-D surface reconstruction framework that refines depth quality and accelerates training by correcting camera intrinsics per frame and using TSDF Fusion prior learning.
